did.description: The account whose queue to list. Omitted = the requester's own account. A requester without administrative standing may name only itself.

peer.description: Only messages exchanged with this counterparty.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a prior page's nextCursor. Echoed verbatim; treated as unstructured by the requester.

limit.description: Maximum messages per page. The mediator chooses a default when omitted.

Response.title: Messaging — List Messages — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a messaging/message/list request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/messaging/message/list/0.1#response.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation token. Present only when further items remain beyond this page; omitted on the final page.
